{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Khar Shian Threat Assessment''''' was a dossier compiled by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Archaeologist]] [[Talos Drellik]] for the benefit of the [[Eternal Alliance]] before the [[Battle of Khar Shian]]. In it he discussed the [[Naga Sadow's fortress|fortress]] on Khar Shian, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] and his [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] experiments, various artefacts such as [[Naga Sadow's sword]], as well as the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors within the Fortress that Sadow experimented on.<ref name="Alchemy">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Naga Sadow's Alchemy}}</ref><ref name="Fortress">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Naga Sadow's Fortress}}</ref><ref name="Monstrosities">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Naga Sadow's Monstrosities}}</ref><ref name="Khar Shian">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Khar Shian}}</ref>
